skills.name: delivery-artifact-builder
skills.changes: a bounded delivery artifact need into the smallest evidence-linked lifecycle specialist and editable artifact
skills.trigger: a ticket implementation review test readiness or release artifact is required
minimum: bounded Feature Delivery Case or change
outputs: specialist selection and editable evidence-linked delivery artifact

skills.name: ticket-ready-package
skills.changes: requirements and delivery context into confirmed and proposed goals non-goals acceptance impact risks tests questions and ticket splits
skills.trigger: a requirement is new ambiguous stalled or not ready for implementation
minimum: bounded requirement or Feature Delivery Case
outputs: Ticket Ready Package and explicit readiness gaps

skills.name: implementation-plan
skills.changes: approved ticket scope and system evidence into work decomposition dependencies critical path validation parallel work and expert decisions
skills.trigger: approved work is complex cross-module multi-contributor or requires sequencing and coordination
outputs: editable implementation plan and explicit planning gaps

skills.name: reviewer-rehearsal
skills.changes: a proposed change and governing evidence into material reviewer challenges missing evidence and author actions
skills.trigger: a complex important cross-boundary or high-risk change is preparing for review
outputs: reviewer challenge rehearsal and evidence completion actions

skills.name: pr-ready-package
skills.changes: a code change and delivery evidence into an editable review package covering intent rationale impact acceptance tests risks monitoring rollback and gaps
skills.trigger: a change is preparing to request review or an existing PR lacks delivery context and evidence
outputs: PR Ready Package and unresolved review gaps

skills.name: test-asset-package
skills.changes: acceptance risk implementation and defect evidence into focused executable validation assets and coverage gaps
skills.trigger: critical behavior needs executable validation during implementation bug fixing review or release preparation
outputs: Test Asset Package and explicit validation gaps

skills.name: delivery-readiness-card
skills.changes: feature lifecycle evidence into a scoped status card showing goal current state gaps launch risks evidence next actions and owners
skills.trigger: a milestone release candidate management review or handoff needs a clear statement of what remains before delivery
outputs: Delivery Readiness Card and explicit delivery gaps

skills.name: pr-to-release-summary
skills.changes: merged or release-candidate change evidence into cross-role release validation rollout rollback limitation support and operations information
skills.trigger: a PR is merged a release candidate exists or release and support communication is being prepared
minimum: PR Ready Package or merged diff
outputs: editable PR-to-Release Summary with sensitive details filtered
